_comment: MCP Config for Skills Bundle by Sujal — Google Antigravity 2.0 / Antigravity IDE
_doc: Place this file at .agents/mcp_config.json. Antigravity discovers it automatically from the .agents/ folder.

filesystem-workspace._comment: Read/write access to workspace files — safe, always-proceed
filesystem-workspace.description: Grants the agent read/write access to files within the workspace root. Used by all builder sub-agents.

postgres-analytics._comment: PostgreSQL analytics database — read-only for reporting, destructive writes require review
postgres-analytics.description: Analytics PostgreSQL database server. Agent can run SELECT queries with always-proceed. INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP require request-review approval.

github-enterprise._comment: GitHub repository operations — reads always-proceed, writes (push/delete) request-review
github-enterprise.description: GitHub MCP server for repository management. Read operations (list repos, get file, list PRs) proceed automatically. Write operations (push, create PR, delete branch) require Boss review.

docker-sandbox._comment: Docker container execution for safe, isolated builds and test runs
docker-sandbox.description: Docker MCP server for isolated command execution. Build and test commands run in a sandboxed container. Prevents side effects from reaching the host system. Container destruction requires request-review.

sast-security-scanner._comment: SAST scanning via semgrep — read-only analysis, always-proceed
sast-security-scanner.description: Static Application Security Testing server using semgrep. Scans source code for SQL injection, XSS, secret leaks, OWASP Top 10 patterns. Read-only — never modifies source. Used by sec_ops_skill.md (Agent 18).

sequential-thinking._comment: Structured multi-step reasoning tool — always-proceed, used during /plan and architecture phases
sequential-thinking.description: Provides structured sequential reasoning for complex multi-step planning tasks. Used by Team Leader (Agent 00) and Architecture Agent (Agent 03) during /plan mode.

brave-search._comment: Web search for research_skill.md (Agent 01) — always-proceed, no writes
brave-search.description: Web search server used by Research Agent (Agent 01) for competitor analysis, CVE lookups, library version checks, and hardware datasheet research. Read-only.
